item.title: [7.3] Yen weak ahead of BOJ decision; rate hike expected
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

The yen dipped against both the dollar and euro as investors speculated about a potential interest rate hike by the Bank of Japan. Meanwhile, the Bank of England opted to maintain steady interest rates, and the euro stayed stable against the dollar.

item.title: [6.9] In-Context Robot Learning with VLM Agents
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Enabling robots to adapt to unfamiliar environments as readily as humans remains a moonshot goal of embodied AI. No finite collection of demonstrations can cover every task and situation a robot will encounter, making the ability to learn from context at deployment essential for generalization. Such in-context learning (ICL), however, remains largely beyond the reach of existing robotic policies.

WHY IT MATTERS

It addresses the critical challenge of in-context robot learning using vision-language models without weight updates, marking a meaningful step forward in embodied AI.

item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Recent work extends recursive self-improvement (RSI) to agent harnesses for long-horizon coding and terminal tasks, enabling agents to improve execution mechanisms from experience. However, generalizable harness RSI remains challenging. First, evolving harnesses on evaluation benchmarks or their subsets makes it difficult to distinguish reusable improvements from benchmark-specific adaptation.

WHY IT MATTERS

item.description:

Scientific agents contribute to hypothesis discovery by synthesizing evidence, assessing proposals, and developing new explanations. Recent systems combine scientific agents with evolutionary search through critique, comparison, and revision.
